change_notes: Initial Streamlit prototype: load data, run pair selection, and inspect a single pair with backtest.
Implement pair canidates save file for loading.
Added A trade proposal based on Pairs analysis
Added full CICD pipe automation for live app deployment
Phase 0 cleanup: removed superseded data loader/downloader modules, fixed price-cache key collisions with a universe-aware hash + freshness metadata, and added unit test coverage for core modules

Phase 1 (start): added a formation/trading walk-forward validation loop with FDR-controlled, multi-fold-stable pair selection, replacing look-ahead-biased full-sample pair scoring; new Walk-forward validation view

Phase 1 (cont.): added leg-level execution costs (commission, half-spread, slippage, short borrow, fill delay) to the backtester and walk-forward, with gross-vs-net equity and a cost breakdown in the Walk-forward validation view

Cache freshness: sidebar shows the price cache's last bar and staleness, 'Update prices' appends only new bars (full re-download if history was restated), and saved pair selections record the prices/settings they came from and refuse to load against a different universe or settings

Phase 2 (start): moved trade-proposal logic out of the UI into core/trade_proposals.py (typed TradeIdea, stable idea/batch ids, skipped-pair reasons, NEW-vs-HELD status); fixed hedge-leg sizing for log-price hedges; ideas are shown as target positions with CSV download

Phase 2: added core/orders.py - OrderLeg/OrderTicket schema with validated lifecycle, fills, deterministic ids, JSON round-trip, and target-position -> delta-order planning (not wired into the UI yet)

Phase 2: added core/risk.py and config/trading_config.json - per-ticket pre-trade risk gates (exposure, pair count, symbol/pair caps, price, data age, kill switch) with recorded reasons; risk-reducing tickets always allowed (not wired into the UI yet)

Phase 2/3 groundwork: added core/portfolio.py - leg-level ledger (cash, average-cost positions, fills, fees, borrow, per-symbol PnL, reconciliation) and a target-share simulator that reproduces the scalar backtest exactly at zero cost (not wired into the UI yet)

Phase 3: added core/broker_base.py (broker interface) and core/broker_paper.py - a persistent SQLite paper broker with idempotent ticket submission, market/limit/partial fills, DAY expiry, borrow, audit log, equity history and reconciliation (not wired into the UI yet)

Phase 4: added the non-UI daily runner (core/daily_run.py + scripts/run_daily_proposals.py) - refresh prices, freshness gate, advance the paper broker, propose risk-checked tickets into a saved run record, and a separate explicit approve-and-submit step; idempotent, single-instance, scheduler-friendly exit codes

Phase 4: monitoring - core/monitoring.py health snapshot and ranked alerts (stale data, overdue run, kill switch, drawdown/exposure near limits, one-legged pairs, reconciliation breaks, stuck/unreviewed tickets), scripts/check_health.py with alert exit codes, and a Paper trading monitor view with an approve-and-submit panel
